mutants.description: Mutant 1: PurgedKFold fails to purge overlapping label windows, leaking test label returns into candidate training sets.
Mutant 2: Lasso coordinate descent uses ordinary linear thresholding without soft-thresholding shrinkage.
Mutant 3: FeatureStore allows future feature observations to be retrieved in as-of queries, introducing lookahead bias.
Mutant 4: TreeSHAPExplainer fails to satisfy local additivity, computing uncalibrated feature attributions.
Mutant 5: ModelRegistry allows direct transition from DRAFT to DEPLOYED without prior validation.
